# AFRICLUB local GoTrue session mutation guard

This directory contains the complete existing installed GoTrue 2.27.2 package,
including its original MIT license and upstream tests. It was copied locally;
no package was downloaded, and the shared pub cache remains unchanged.
`UPSTREAM_PROVENANCE.json` records every original file hash and byte count.
`UPSTREAM_PUBSPEC.yaml` preserves the exact original package metadata.

The local patch checks the SDK session version and a pending-authentication
operation generation immediately before anonymous sign-in, OTP verification or
account-edit responses can change the active SDK session or publish auth events.
Logout invalidates pending mutations. Repository lifecycle cancellation uses
client-bound operation scopes so disposal of an old repository cannot cancel a
new repository's pending login, including on the same SDK client. Successful
current operations still publish the SDK event before returning their response;
ordinary token refresh remains supported.

MFA verification also retains the caller's SDK session identity. A late
verification response after an account switch, logout or session renewal cannot
publish an assurance response or install its session. Other MFA actions keep
their upstream SDK behavior; the native caller separately owns and checks its
setup and factor-operation results. The verification regression tests use the actual SDK and intercepted
HTTP in `test/mfa_session_owner_test.dart`; they cover successful current
verification as well as stale responses. These tests do not assert deployed
provider or physical-device acceptance.

Logout also checks the cleared session version after awaited PKCE storage
cleanup. A newly installed session cannot receive the older operation's
`signedOut` event; an ordinary logout still publishes its own event.

The local `pubspec.yaml` omits the publisher's `resolution: workspace` because
this package is consumed through the AFRICLUB root path override. Its name,
version, runtime dependencies and upstream license are retained. This is an
AFRICLUB maintained source patch, not a claimed new upstream release.

Regression evidence is generated by the actual SDK/intercepted-HTTP cases in
`packages/core/core_auth/test/auth_repository_cleanup_test.dart`. Before-fix
failures and final source bindings are retained in the local readiness evidence.

The consumer analysis options retain normal Dart static diagnostics without
requiring the publisher-only `supabase_lints` development package. Upstream
style is preserved; behavioral regression tests run through the application
with this exact local package selected. The original analysis options hash is
recorded in the upstream manifest.
